tools.name: AddDut
tools.description: Adds a Data Unit Type (STRUCT, ENUM, ALIAS, UNION) to the PLC project.

DutType.description: DUT type: Struct, Enum, Alias, Union.

Fields.description: Optional object of field declarations (name = type) for Struct/Union (name = value for Enum). Declaration order is not guaranteed (PowerShell hashtable).

tools.name: AddGvl
tools.description: Adds a Global Variable List (GVL) to the PLC project.

Variables.description: Optional object of variable declarations (name = type). Declaration order is not guaranteed (PowerShell hashtable).

tools.name: AddLibrary
tools.description: Adds a library reference to the PLC project.

Version.description: Optional library version. Uses latest if omitted.

tools.name: AddPou
tools.description: Adds a POU (Program, Function Block, or Function) to the PLC project.

Type.description: POU type: Program, FunctionBlock, or Function.

ReturnType.description: Return type for Functions (e.g., INT, BOOL). Ignored for Program/FunctionBlock.

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path of the folder the POU is created in, e.g. TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs (same on 4024 and 4026). Omit to auto-detect (<Plc> Project^POUs, else the <Plc> Project node; see data.folderPath).

tools.name: BuildProject
tools.description: Build the PLC project of the open solution and wait for the result. On BUILD_FAILED read data.errorItems / data.codeErrors (description/file/line taken from the XAE Error List) instead of guessing. Warnings come with their contents: data.warningItems (same shape) and data.codeWarnings (without Library Manager items), unless data.errorListError is set. A full build can take several minutes (timeout 600 s). Requires ConnectIde with an open solution.

tools.name: ConnectAds
tools.description: Open the ADS connection to the PLC runtime. Leave AmsNetId empty: it is auto-detected from the IDE target and changes per target (local UmRT, remote CX ...), so never hardcode it. Port defaults to 851 (PLC runtime 1). Requires ConnectIde for auto-detection.

AmsNetId.description: Target AmsNetId. Leave empty to auto-detect from the IDE target (recommended; it differs per target).

tools.name: ConnectIde
tools.description: Connect to a running TwinCAT XAE / Visual Studio instance (found through the Running Object Table); only if none is found does it launch a new XAE. SolutionPath is optional and opens that .sln after connecting. Call this before any project, build or runtime tool. Returns ideProcessId, connectSec (total seconds), launchSec (only when a new IDE was launched: seconds until DTE was ready) and, when a solution is open, the detected target AmsNetId.

ProgId.description: COM ProgID to connect to / launch. When given, running instances with this ProgID are preferred and only this ProgID is used for launching.

SolutionPath.description: Path to a .sln file. If specified, the IDE will open this solution automatically after connecting (or connect to an instance already running this solution).

NoLaunch.description: If set, do not launch a new IDE instance if none is running.

tools.name: DisconnectAds
tools.description: Close the ADS connection and forget the cached endpoint (disables auto-reconnect).

tools.name: DisconnectIde
tools.description: Release the DTE/COM references held by the bridge. The IDE keeps running unless Quit=true, which closes the solution without saving and quits the IDE (only use on an IDE that ConnectIde launched). With Quit=true a modal dialog is checked first: if one is up nothing is attempted, nothing is released (the connection stays: for kind reload-prompt run ResetSolution, then DisconnectIde Quit=true again) and the result is IDE_QUIT_FAILED (data.dialog {title, text, kind, reloadTarget}, quit=false, disconnected=false); if DTE.Quit fails the result is also IDE_QUIT_FAILED (success=false, data.ideProcessId / quitError; the IDE process still runs). After a failure the IDE pid is kept, so DisconnectIde Quit=true Kill=true can follow directly without ConnectIde. Kill=true (only with Quit=true) kills the IDE process in those two cases, but only when this session launched it (data.ownedBySession, still true after the internal reconnect of ResetSolution), otherwise IDE_NOT_OWNED and nothing is killed; data.killed tells whether it was killed. COM references are always released.

Quit.description: true = also close the solution (without saving) and quit the IDE.

Kill.description: Only with Quit=true: kill the IDE process when it cannot be quit (modal dialog, DTE.Quit failed). Only for an IDE this session launched (data.ownedBySession); any other IDE -> IDE_NOT_OWNED, nothing killed.

tools.name: EnableConfig
tools.description: Activate the configuration on the target without any dialog. Restarts TwinCAT and downloads/starts the PLC program: the machine stops and restarts. Confirm with the user first. With Force=true it runs the whole lifecycle: Config -> Activate -> wait for Run -> PLC Login+Download -> wait for port 851 -> PLC Run, and reports every step in data.steps. NoLogin=true stops after TwinCAT is in Run (no download, no PLC Run). TwinCAT restarts, so call ConnectAds again afterwards (ReadVariable/WriteVariable also auto-reconnect; data.reconnected tells you). Never add sleeps around this call; it polls until the target state is reached.

Force.description: true = full lifecycle without dialogs (Config -> Activate -> Run -> Login/Download -> PLC Run).

NoLogin.description: true = stop after TwinCAT reaches Run; skip PLC login/download/Run.

TimeoutSec.description: Overall time limit for the whole -Force cycle (single deadline). Default 120.

tools.name: GetBuildErrors
tools.description: Read the compiler messages currently shown in the XAE Error List: data.counts {errors, warnings, messages}, data.errors[] and data.warnings[] (IncludeWarnings defaults to true; IncludeWarnings=false skips the warning toggle and saves 1-2 s); IncludeMessages=true adds data.messages[]. Items are {severity, code, description, project, file, line, column}. Counts are read from the summary buttons in English and zh-TW UI; other UI languages return ERRORLIST_UNAVAILABLE.

IncludeWarnings.description: Default on; -IncludeWarnings:$false skips the warning toggle (saves 1-2 s of UIA). Also reads warning rows (data.warnings, always present when on, possibly empty).

TimeoutSec.description: Hard limit for the UI Automation scan. Default 30.

tools.name: GetIdeInfo
tools.description: Return version, edition, open solution and ITcSysManager availability of the connected IDE. Cheap connectivity check; fails with NOT_CONNECTED before ConnectIde.

tools.name: GetIoTree
tools.description: Reads the current I/O device tree (TIID subtree) and returns as JSON.

tools.name: GetPlcState
tools.description: Read the PLC runtime state (Run/Stop/...) on the connected ADS port.

tools.name: GetPouCode
tools.description: Reads declaration and implementation code from an existing POU.

PouName.description: Name of the POU to read.

PouPath.description: Full tree path; omit to auto-detect from PouName (POUs folder -> project root -> tree search depth 4, see data.pouPath / data.resolvedBy). Format on 4024 and 4026: TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^<name>; DUT ...^DUTs^<name>, GVL ...^GVLs^<name>. Use GetProjectTree with PlcOnly=true to list paths.

tools.name: GetProjectTree
tools.description: Read the project tree. Every node has name, path, type, itemType, subType and children; path can be passed as-is to GetPouCode / WritePouCode PouPath. type is the item kind from ItemType (Project, Folder, FunctionBlock, Function, Program, Dut, Gvl, Task, References ...) or the numeric ItemType when unknown (itemType / subType are also returned as numbers). The PLC node TIPC^<Plc> also lists "<Plc> Project" with its POUs, DUTs and GVLs folders (on 4024 and 4026 the project node is hidden from enumeration and is added by path). Depth (default 4) = levels below each root, enough for TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^<POU>; a node at the depth limit that still has children comes back with children=[] and truncated=true. PlcOnly=true returns only the TIPC subtree.

Depth.description: Levels below each root node (1-10, default 4). 4 reaches the POUs: TIPC(0)^<Plc>(1)^<Plc> Project(2)^POUs(3)^<POU>(4). Nodes at the limit that have children return truncated=true.

PlcOnly.description: true = return only the TIPC (PLC) subtree.

tools.name: GetSymbols
tools.description: List the PLC symbols of the connected runtime, optionally filtered by a substring (Filter): path, type, size, comment, and for enum types enumValues (member name -> value). Use it to find exact variable paths and types before ReadVariable/WriteVariable.

tools.name: GetSystemState
tools.description: Read the TwinCAT system state (Run/Config) of a target over ADS port 10000. AmsNetId defaults to the IDE target (ConnectIde), then the ADS session (ConnectAds), then the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1; data.amsNetId / data.netIdSource tell which one was used. netIdSource=local means you read the local TwinCAT system, which is usually NOT your target.

AmsNetId.description: Target AmsNetId. Leave empty to use the IDE target, then the ADS session, then the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1 (see data.netIdSource).

tools.name: IoScan
tools.description: Scan the I/O devices (EtherCAT ...) of the target and add them to the I/O tree. Requires the target in Config mode.

tools.name: NewProject
tools.description: Creates a new TwinCAT XAE project with a PLC project and default MAIN program.

Path.description: Directory to create the project in. Defaults to current directory.

tools.name: NewTestCase
tools.description: Build a test case object for RunTest/RunTestCycle. Setup/Teardown are arrays of {Path, Value} writes; Assertions are {Path, Operator, Expected} with Operator one of Equal (default), NotEqual, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, Contains, IsTrue, IsFalse. Pure data, no IDE/PLC access.

Setup.description: Writes before the test: array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":1} (keys Path = PLC symbol path, Value = value to write, converted to the PLC type).

Teardown.description: Writes after the test (also run when the test fails): array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":0} (keys Path, Value).

WaitMs.description: Wait duration in milliseconds before assertions.

Assertions.description: Checks after WaitMs: array of {"Path":"MAIN.y","Operator":"Equal","Expected":1}. Keys: Path (PLC symbol path), Operator (optional, default Equal; one of Equal, NotEqual, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, Contains, IsTrue, IsFalse), Expected (omit for IsTrue/IsFalse). Short forms like "eq"/"gt" are NOT accepted.

tools.name: OpenProject
tools.description: Open a solution (.sln) in the connected IDE and wait until the TwinCAT project is loaded.

tools.name: PlcLogin
tools.description: Login to the PLC project and download the program in one call (Login flag 3, no dialogs). Use after a successful BuildProject when TwinCAT is already in Run; EnableConfig Force=true already includes this step.

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path to PLC project. Default auto-detects from TIPC.

LoginMode.description: Regular (default): PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS_REGULAR - login, download only when the runtime has no program (XAE decides). Download: FORCEDOWNLOAD - always a full download (used by Send-TcPlcProgram). OnlineChange: FORCEONLINECHANGE. SILENT (256) is only OR-ed in with -SilentFlag.

tools.name: PlcLogout
tools.description: Log out of the PLC project (the runtime keeps running).

tools.name: ReadVariable
tools.description: Read one or more PLC variables by symbol path (e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter","GVL.bRun"]) via ADS. Path is always an array, even for a single variable. Each entry has path, value, type: BOOL/integers/REAL/STRING are plain values; TIME/TOD, LTIME/LTOD, DATE/DT, LDATE/LDT return the IEC literal in value ("T#6s", "DT#2026-10-20-12:30:00") plus the raw integer in ms (TIME/TOD), ns (LTIME/LTOD/LDATE/LDT) or unix (DATE/DT); enums return the integer in value plus the member name in name; STRUCT/ARRAY return the raw bytes in value plus size. Requires ConnectAds (auto-reconnects after EnableConfig).

Path.description: Array of PLC symbol paths, e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter"]. Always an array, also for a single variable.

tools.name: ResetSolution
tools.description: Reload every project file from disk: dismisses the reload prompt if it is up (data.dismissedReloadPrompt). The XAE project prompt "The project file ... has been modified outside of TwinCAT XAE. Do you want to reload the project?" (a rewritten .plcproj; GetIdeModalDialog kind reload-prompt, reloadTarget project) is answered Yes by dialog control id (any UI language) and XAE reloads the project itself: then only ConnectIde runs again, no close / reopen (data.answeredYes=true, data.reopenedSolution=false, data.reloadTarget). Otherwise it closes all documents without saving (data.closedDocuments), Solution.Close, Solution.Open of the same .sln on the same IDE, then ConnectIde again (20-25 s in total, data.totalSec). Use right after .TcPOU / .plcproj files were changed ON DISK by another tool while they are open in an XAE editor: otherwise XAE shows the modal "File has been changed outside the environment. Reload the new file?" (GetIdeModalDialog kind reload-prompt) and every call blocks. A file that is not open in an editor is picked up automatically within ~5 s and needs no call; WritePouCode writes the IDE edit buffer through COM and never needs it (the file on disk is only written on save / BuildProject). Any other modal dialog is reported as IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. The ADS connection is kept.

SolutionPath.description: .sln to reopen. Default: the solution ConnectIde / OpenProject opened.

TimeoutSec.description: Expected upper bound for each of Documents.CloseAll, Solution.Close and Solution.Open in seconds (default 120).

tools.name: RunTest
tools.description: Execute one test case created with NewTestCase (setup writes -> wait -> assertions -> teardown writes) against the connected PLC. Requires ConnectAds.

TestCase.description: A test case object as returned by NewTestCase.

tools.name: RunTestCycle
tools.description: Builds, activates (TwinCAT restart) and runs the PLC: changes the running machine. Confirm with the user first. Full automated test cycle: build (unless SkipBuild), activate configuration, login, run every test case from NewTestCase, then stop the PLC (unless KeepRunning). Returns per-test results. Can take many minutes (timeout 900 s).

TestCases.description: Array of test case objects as returned by NewTestCase.

SkipBuild.description: Skip the build step (if already built).

KeepRunning.description: Don't stop the PLC after tests complete.

tools.name: SendPlcProgram
tools.description: Download the compiled PLC program to the target (alias of PlcLogin: Login+Download without dialogs).

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path to PLC project. Default auto-detects from TIPC.

tools.name: SetPlcState
tools.description: Switch the PLC runtime to Run, Stop or Reset and wait for the state. WARNING: on a UmRT (user-mode runtime) target, Reset kills TcSystemServiceUm and you must EnableConfig again. Prefer Run/Stop.

State.description: Run, Stop or Reset. Reset kills TcSystemServiceUm on a UmRT target.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum wait for Run/Stop to be reached. Default 30.

tools.name: SetSystemState
tools.description: Switch TwinCAT to Run or Config via ADS WriteControl (no StartRestartTwinCAT dialog) and poll until the state is reached. Switching to Config stops the runtime: all outputs go to zero. Does not download the PLC program; EnableConfig Force=true is the usual choice.

AmsNetId.description: Target AMS Net ID. Optional; resolved from the IDE target, then the ADS session. Never falls back to the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time to wait for the target state. Default 60.

tools.name: SetTarget
tools.description: Sets the target system AMS Net ID for deployment.

AmsNetId.description: Target AMS Net ID (e.g., "127.0.0.1.1.1" for local).

tools.name: SetVariableLink
tools.description: Links a PLC variable to an I/O channel.

tools.name: WatchVariable
tools.description: Poll one or more PLC variables (Path is an array; every round reads each path in order) every IntervalMs. Without Until it samples for DurationMs (default 2000). With Until it waits for a condition '<Path> <op> <value>' (op: == != > < >= <=, e.g. 'MAIN.fTarget == 123.5' or 'MAIN.bDone == TRUE'; <Path> must be one of Path) and returns as soon as it holds or after UntilTimeoutMs (default 5000): data.untilMet, untilSample, elapsedMs. Numbers compare numerically, TRUE/FALSE as booleans, other values as case-insensitive text; a failed read never satisfies the condition. Only the last KeepLast samples are returned (default 20 with Until, 50 without); sampleCount is the total and truncated tells whether older samples were dropped. Single-path samples are {timestamp, value} plus ms/ns/unix for TIME/DATE types and name for enums (same conversion as ReadVariable; a numeric Until value compares with that raw integer, text with the IEC literal / enum member name), multi-path samples {timestamp, values:{<path>:<value>}}. Use Until instead of a long DurationMs or repeated ReadVariable calls. Requires ConnectAds.

Path.description: One or more variable paths to monitor, e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter"] or ["MAIN.fActual","MAIN.bDone"]. Always an array.

IntervalMs.description: Delay between sampling rounds in milliseconds. Default: 100.

DurationMs.description: Sampling duration in ms when Until is not given (default 2000).

Until.description: Stop condition '<Path> <op> <value>' with op one of == != > < >= <=, e.g. 'MAIN.fTarget == 123.5'. <Path> must be in Path (case-insensitive).

UntilTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in ms to wait for Until before returning untilMet=false. Default 5000.

TimeoutMs.description: Legacy alias of UntilTimeoutMs; used only when UntilTimeoutMs is not given.

KeepLast.description: Number of most recent samples to return. 0 = auto (20 with Until, 50 without). sampleCount still counts every round; truncated=true when older samples were dropped.

tools.name: WritePouCode
tools.description: Writes declaration and/or implementation code into an existing POU.

PouName.description: Name of the POU to write to.

PouPath.description: Full tree path; omit to auto-detect from PouName (POUs folder -> project root -> tree search depth 4, see data.pouPath / data.resolvedBy). Format on 4024 and 4026: TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^<name>; DUT ...^DUTs^<name>, GVL ...^GVLs^<name>. Use GetProjectTree with PlcOnly=true to list paths.

tools.name: WriteVariable
tools.description: Write a single PLC variable by symbol path via ADS. Writes directly into the running PLC; may drive outputs or axes. Confirm with the user first. Value is converted to the PLC type of the symbol: JSON bool for BOOL, number for integer/REAL types, string for STRING; TIME/TOD take an IEC literal ("T#6s", "T#1m30s500ms", "TOD#12:30:00"; integer ms also accepted), LTIME/LTOD "LTIME#1us" (or integer ns), DATE/DT "D#2026-10-20" / "DT#2026-10-20-12:30:00" / ISO 8601 (or integer seconds since 1970), enums an integer or the member name. STRUCT/ARRAY cannot be written as a whole (TYPE_MISMATCH): write their members. data.written is the value actually written: the normalized literal for time types ("T#6000ms" -> "T#6s", raw integer in ms/ns/unix), the converted number otherwise, plus name for enums. Requires ConnectAds.

Value.description: New value matching the PLC type of the symbol: JSON bool (BOOL), number (integer/REAL/LREAL), string (STRING). TIME/TOD: "T#6s" / "T#1m30s500ms" / "TOD#12:30:00" (integer ms also accepted); LTIME/LTOD: "LTIME#1us" (or integer ns); DATE/DT: "D#2026-10-20", "DT#2026-10-20-12:30:00" or ISO 8601 (or integer seconds since 1970); LDATE/LDT: "LDT#..." (or integer ns); enum: integer or member name ("READY").
